To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) visual analytics is an appropriate approach for behavior-based malware analysts, (2) knowledge externalization is a promising approach to ease the analysis process, and (3) visual analytics and knowledge-assisted analysis can be combined to support the analyst with both, the analysis process and the externalization process.
KAMAS supports analysts with visual analytics methods and knowledge externalization for the analysis of large collections of execution logs from malware samples.

KAMAS is a promising system for malware analysts, but it requires a lot of effort to learn and use.
